# gpg_key (Data Source)

Reads an OpenPGP key's metadata and armored public key from a gpg secrets engine mount.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gpg_key" "app" {
  backend = "gpg"
  name    = "app"
}

output "app_fingerprint" {
  value = data.gpg_key.app.fingerprint
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backend` (String) Mount path of the gpg secrets engine.
- `name` (String) Name of the key.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) Key algorithm.
- `deletion_allowed` (Boolean) Whether the key may be deleted.
- `exportable` (Boolean) Whether the private key is exportable.
- `fingerprint` (String) OpenPGP fingerprint of the latest version.
- `identity` (String) OpenPGP User ID.
- `key_id` (String) OpenPGP key ID of the latest version.
- `latest_version` (Number) Current (highest) key version.
- `min_decryption_version` (Number) Minimum key version usable for decryption.
- `public_key` (String) Armored public key of the latest version.
